Constellation membership — gretaR

Source: CONSTELLATION_MEMBER.md

This project is a MEMBER of the flexyBayes Constellation. Joined 2026-06-02. A constellation is a set of independent R&D projects organised in full support of one leader. This file is gretaR’s back-pointer to that leader and charter.

  • Leader: flexyBayes.
  • My role: engine — torch-native Bayesian MCMC (no Python); a producer.
  • Contracts I honour: C1 backend_contract (v1, owned by flexyBayes).
  • My edge: gretaR -> flexyBayes — status activating (ratified 2026-06-02); non-hierarchical live, default hierarchical fitting gated on the NUTS perf fix.
  • What binds me (charter invariants):
    • Standalone-functional — gretaR must keep working and R CMD check clean with no sibling member installed; no hard Imports: on another member.
    • Version floor — the C1 edge requires gretaR >= 0.4.0 (currently met).
    • Leader-directed adoption — I align my R&D to the leader’s published direction; I may propose innovations (a constellation_c1 ledger cairn), the leader arbitrates adoption by the prospects of leader + team.
  • Canonical charter: flexyBayes_dev/CONSTELLATION.md (also in the MaxAIbase brain, open tier). Leader decision: cairn flexyBayes_dev/ledger/infrastructure/2026-06-02-constellation-charter-v01.

I remain independently developed and separately publishable. Membership is cooperation, not coupling.

Developed by Max Moldovan.
